items.title: Ukraine: Attacks on education threaten an entire generation, UNICEF warns
items.summary: In an underground classroom in Sumy, Ukraine, children sit quietly at their desks, busy with the day’s lessons. For the moment they are shielded from the horrors of nearly five years of war, but just barely.
